Maya Patel: FYI team  small shuffle in Platform + Runtime this sprint — please skim when you have a sec.
Maya Patel: Starting Mon Apr 14 Samir Desai will join as Staff Platform Engineer (IC) focusing on serving reliability; Kelsey Tran is stepping into Engineering Manager, Runtime; Priya Nair will cover as interim Runtime Lead while we run the search.
Maya Patel: Reporting lines: Samir -> Platform eng (Jorge will be the onboarding lead), Kelsey -> Eng Managers (matrixed to Runtime). Priya will keep day-to-day on rollouts and pagers until we fill the role.
Maya Patel: Quick asks: 1) @eng-infra - please fast-track perms and cluster access for Samir; 2) @people-ops - schedule benefits intro + badge pickup; 3) Runtime owners - hand off any active canaries to Priya.
Samir Desai: excited to join Redwood. coming from a serving + observability background. start date Mon Apr 14. Ping me for pairing on autoscaler work.
Kelsey Tran: thanks all. I'll set up a quick "meet the managers" slot and open a weekly sync for runtime infra.
Arun Singh: welcome Samir  happy to pair on KV cache and batching work next week.
Priya Nair: I'll own the oncall coverage and the current model-v3 rollout. @Maya can you share the hiring timeline so I can coordinate interview shadows?
Maya Patel: Hiring plan: req PLAT-209 opened today, expect interviews in 2-3 weeks, target hire by end of May. I'll post the rubric and interviewers in #people-ops-hiring.
Lizzy Mendoza: Welcome @Samir and congrats @Kelsey! People Ops will send laptop + accessories within 2 business days and calendar invites for orientation. Please complete new-hire forms by EOD Fri.
people-ops-bot: New hire checklist created for Samir Desai. Reminder: benefits enrollment deadline in 30 days.
Samir Desai: can someone add me to #eng-infra and grant read access to model-serving docs?
Arun Singh: added a note in the repo to unassign any stale PRs and tag Samir for review.
Priya Nair: DM'd Kelsey the canary runbook and current incident logs.
Maya Patel: We'll hold a short intro huddle Tue 9am PT. When you meet them please drop a one-liner here so we can welcome them asynchronously. Thanks! :wave:
